root_cause.text: In scpsys_get_bus_protection_legacy(), the device node obtained from of_find_node_with_property() is released via of_node_put() before checking whether syscon_regmap_lookup_by_phandle() fails, leading to a use-after-free when the error path dereferences the node pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message explicitly state: "If an error occurs, dev_err_probe() dereferences the node pointer to print diagnostic information, but the node memory may have already been freed due to the earlier of_node_put()". The patch moves of_node_put(node) after the IS_ERR(regmap[2]) error check to prevent this.
